items.summary:
Before signing up for reality TV, several newbies from The Real Housewives of New Jersey received some priceless advice from the show’s veterans.

“All three OGs told me, ‘Xio, just be you,’” Xio Cammarota  exclusively told Us during the season 15 premiere party at the Crane Club in New York City on Tuesday, November 17. “And believe me, I called all of them, and I was like, ‘Tell me, tell me, tell me.’ And they were like, ‘Just be you. Don’t try to plan anything. Just be you.’ And I was like, ‘Well, I only know how to be me, so that’s what we’re going to do.’”

Last month, Us exclusively revealed the cast for season 15 of Bravo’s hit reality show.

Melissa Gorga , Teresa Giudice and Dolores Catania will join Xio, 47, Malvina Blloshmi , Juliette Collazo , Deeba Patel , Natia Rufolo and Vanessa Barrera for a season filled with fresh friendships, family dynamics and business ambitions.

RHONJ’s Melissa Gorga Reveals Her Holiday Plans With Teresa Giudice 

After cameras started rolling, Natia, 36, remembered the words of wisdom she received from Melissa, 47, Teresa, 54, and Dolores, 55.

“They’ve actually offered me the same advice,” she told Us . “I was surprised. I even told them, I was like, ‘You guys literally told me the same thing.’ They said, ‘Just be yourself.’”

Vanessa, 42, who was wearing a black leather fringed outfit from Project Runway’ s Jesus and Antonio Estrada for the premiere party, added, “All the OGs have always said, ‘You know what, V? Just be genuinely yourself. Be authentic to who you are and what you say, own it.’”

items.title: Mom Charged With Murder After 2 Sons Died in Fire While Home Alone
items.summary:
A single mother in Georgia was charged with murder after her two sons died in a fire when they were allegedly left home alone.

The Valdosta Police Department claimed that Taneika Lashae Sirmans left her three sons under the age of 10 home alone at their residence in Valdosta, Georgia, in the early morning of October 25 while she was at work.

Sirmans, 37, was still at work at 8:20 a.m. when a fire suddenly broke out in the home’s kitchen.

First responders reported to the scene and noted that the fire was coming from the roof of the home. Authorities managed to enter the home and removed the three boys.

Woman Arrested After 6 Kids Were Found in 'Unlivable' Home With Feces on Floor 

All three boys were found unresponsive, and first responders performed life-saving measures on all of the victims as they were rushed to nearby hospitals to receive treatment.

The police department said that the two youngest boys ultimately died of smoke inhalation once they got to the hospital. Meanwhile, the oldest brother remains hospitalized and is in stable condition after he was airlifted to a facility in Atlanta for treatment.

Following the tragedy, Sirmans took to Facebook on November 7 to identify her two sons that died as 5-year-old Messiah Jace Wims and 3-year-old Malachi Ja’Kari Sirmans.

“My babies,My babies i love yall so much,” Sirmans wrote alongside a graphic that featured photos of the boys and shared information about their funeral services.

The Valdosta Police Department obtained arrest warrants for Sirmans for three counts of cruelty to children in the second degree…
items.t: Mom Charged With Murder After 2 Sons Died in Fire While Home Alone

items.title: Expert Predicts Grim Fate for Missing Travis Turner as 1-Year Mark Approaches
items.summary:
A criminal justice expert has issued an ominous opinion about missing high school football coach Travis Turner as the one-year anniversary of his disappearance looms.  

“He’s probably no longer with us,” Dr. Ken Lang , the associate professor of criminology and criminal justice at Milligan University, said Tuesday, November 17, on News Channel 11’s Crime Watch . “Because of the crime that he’s been charged with [and] what he knew what was about to come to light — remember, the arrest warrant comes after he goes missing — he realizes what’s about to happen and what’s to unfold. I think he’s probably no longer with us at this point.” 

Turner, 46, has been missing since November 20, 2025 , when he was allegedly last seen by members of his family walking into the wooded area behind his Virginia home while carrying a rifle.  

After he disappeared, Turner — the former head football coach at Union High School in Big Stone Gap, Virginia — was charged with five counts of child pornography and five counts of using a computer to solicit a minor.  

Rex Ryan Accused of Having ‘Small Penis’ by Pedestrians He Allegedly Ran Over 

When asked to specify what he thinks happened to Turner, Dr. Lang said, “I’m speaking about specifically suicide, because of the shame that these types of offenders will have when they’ve been discovered.” 

“Particularly if this is the first [time] they’ve been discovered,” he added. “They’re not a registered sex offender. They have no known background to anyone else. When this comes to light to the family, to co-workers and others, it brings about a lot of…
items.t: Expert Predicts Grim Fate for Missing Travis Turner as 1-Year Mark Approaches

items.title: Tony Bennett's Son Names the 2 Artists He Wishes Dad Got to Sing With
items.summary:
Tony Bennett ‘s son Danny Bennett wishes his father had the opportunity to record one more installment of his award-winning Duets albums prior to his death .

“I’ve been thinking about what that third duet record would be, and it would be with artists like Billie Eilish and Ariana Grande ,” Danny, who managed his late dad’s career from 1979 until his retirement in 2021, exclusively told Us at the Tony Bennett 100th Birthday Benefit in New York City on Tuesday, November 17. “I missed that opportunity ’cause I think that would’ve been wonderful.”

Danny, 72, noted that “demographics meant nothing” to Tony, who was known for uplifting and working with younger artists in his final years.

“It was said that he didn’t bridge the generation gap — he destroyed it,” Danny added. “And I’m very proud to be a part of that.”

Tony Bennett Through the Years: Grammy Wins, Family Life and More 

Tony released several collaborative albums during his seven-decade career, starting with 2001’s Playin’ With My Friends: Bennett Sings the Blues . His most famous entry was 2006’s Duets: An American Classic , on which he sang with Barbra Streisand , Paul McCartney , Elton John , Billy Joel , Céline Dion , Stevie Wonder and more. Its 2011 sequel, Duets II , featured the likes of Lady Gaga , John Mayer , Amy Winehouse , Aretha Franklin and Mariah Carey .

Danny Bennett and Billy Joel Brendon Cook/BFA.com

Nicolas Cage used a bit of movie magic to gain 60 pounds for his transformation into late Oakland Raiders coach John Madden .

“[It was] sort of a hybrid of gaining weight — I gained about 25 pounds and added some prosthetics to achieve a 60-pound look,” Cage, 62, told E! News at the premiere of the Madden biopic earlier this month, explaining that he wanted to avoid the “frozen mask” look of solely relying on prosthetics.

“Enough of myself where I could still be expressive,” he added.

In Madden , which was released in select theaters on November 11 and begins streaming on Amazon Prime Video on Wednesday, November 18, Cage portrays the titular football icon, who served as the head coach of the Oakland Raiders from 1969 to 1978. Madden led the team to eight playoff appearances, seven division titles, seven AFL/AFC Championship Game appearances and their first Super Bowl title in 1977 before his retirement in 1979. He died from complications of a stroke at age 85 in December 2021.

While Cage transformed himself physically for the role, he also made sure to prepare himself mentally.

“I’m not an impressionist. I lean more toward being a surrealist,” Cage told E! at the premiere in California on November 4. “I’m trying to find the energy, the imagination, the heart of the man and dig deep within and try to inform it with something that is emotionally accurate.”

items.title: Travis Kelce Recalls Taylor Swift's 1st Chiefs Game: 'I'm a Lucky Man'
items.summary:
Travis Kelce still holds his now-wife Taylor Swift ’s first Kansas City Chiefs football game close to his heart.

“I’m a lucky man,” Kelce, 37, told ESPN in a Wednesday, November 18, profile about Swift’s presence at Arrowhead Stadium. “The fans in general make it so hospitable for everybody, not even just my family.”

Kelce and Swift, 36, started dating in 2023 after the Chiefs tight end publicly revealed via his podcast that he wanted to give the pop star his number. Soon enough, Swift privately reached out, and the duo began seeing each other. The duo took their romance public in September 2023 when Swift attended her first Chiefs game, sitting with Kelce’s mom in a private suite.

“Once they figured out that that was my suite, it’s a game-day experience that has gone far beyond my imagination,” Kelce added of the fan attention. “It’s pretty cool.”

Travis Kelce Says He’s ‘Proud’ That Taylor Swift Is His ‘Lady’  

Despite Kelce’s enthusiasm, a cohort of fans criticized the NFL for frequently showing Swift on the jumbotron and during TV broadcasts. Swift, however, hasn’t paid the chatter any mind, remaining focused on cheering on Kelce.

Jamie Squire/Getty Images 
 “I don’t know how they know what suite I’m in. There’s a camera, like, a half-mile away, and you don’t know where it is, and you have no idea when the camera is putting you in the broadcast, so I don’t know if I’m being shown 17 times or once,” she told TIME in her 2023 Person of the Year cover story . “I’m just there to support Travis. I have no awareness of if I’m being shown too much and pissing off a few…

items.title: Parents Allegedly Refused to Call 911 as Their 6-Year-Old's Health Declined
items.summary:
Two parents in North Carolina were arrested after they allegedly refused to call 911 for help despite their 6-year-old child’s dire medical condition.

Jacob William McNinch and Danielle Renee Stanton have been both charged with child abuse with great bodily harm.

McNinch, 29, was also hit with an additional charge of assault on a female (domestic violence) after he allegedly punched Stanton, 30, in the face. Stanton was left with a black eye, which was visible in her mugshot.

The Nash County Sheriff’s Office announced in a press release that deputies responded to a call on Monday, November 16, regarding an unresponsive child at a home in Bailey, North Carolina.

Parents Arrested After 1-Month-Old Dies With Bruises on His Body 

Upon their arrival, first responders performed life-saving measures on the child before they were rushed to a hospital. Doctors pronounced the child dead after their arrival.

Following the child’s death, an investigation was launched into the family’s home life to determine what led to the child’s death. While authorities have not yet said what evidence they found amid the investigation, the arrest warrant claimed that McNinch and Stanton failed to call 911 or seek medical help for their child despite the victim’s declining health, according to Law & Crime .

The warrant also claimed that the family’s hazardous “living environment” led to the victim’s death.

Authorities have not yet publicly identified the child or revealed the cause and manner of their death. It’s also not known if the couple had a history of domestic violence in their home,…
items.t: Parents Allegedly Refused to Call 911 as Their 6-Year-Old's Health Declined

items.title: Man Murdered Ex's Siblings, Their Partners in Quadruple 'Revenge' Killing: DA
items.summary:
A 21-year-old man will spend the rest of his life in prison after he pleaded guilty to murdering his ex-boyfriend’s two siblings and their partners inside a California home, which he set on fire in an effort to conceal the “revenge” killings, as detailed by prosecutors.

Miguel Diego Sandoval was sentenced on Tuesday, November 18, to four consecutive life sentences without the possibility of parole, per Fox 11 Los Angeles . He was 19 at the time of the Los Angeles County murders.

Sandoval, “angered” by the end of his romantic relationship, broke into a Lancaster home and fatally shot his ex’s siblings and their romantic partners after he waited outside the residence for them to go to sleep on November 16, 2024, according to the Los Angeles County District Attorney’s Office.

He killed siblings Christine Aca-ac and Janvi Maquindang , as well as Edwin Garcia and Matthew Montebello , prosecutors said.

Man Shot Ex-Wife and Her New Boyfriend in a Crime of 'Passion,' Police Say 

Sandoval also killed three dogs inside the house before setting the home ablaze, Fox 11 Los Angeles reported. Two minors who were stuck inside the burning home survived.

One of the minors, a 16-year-old, called 911 from the house, leading to Los Angeles County sheriff’s deputies rescuing her from a locked bedroom, according to prosecutors. Sandoval allegedly fled by the time authorities arrived.

Sandoval pleaded guilty to four counts of first-degree murder in August in the deaths of Aca-ac, 25, Maquindang, 21, Garcia, 24, and Montebello, 21, in addition to other charges, including arson, according…
items.t: Man Murdered Ex's Siblings, Their Partners in Quadruple 'Revenge' Killing: DA

items.title: Teresa Giudice Opens Up About Hopes for Ex Joe’s Presidential Pardon
items.summary:
The Real Housewives of New Jersey star Teresa Giudice is hopeful that her ex-husband, Joe Giudice , will receive a presidential pardon.

“I would love for [President Donald] Trump to pardon Joe,” Teresa exclusively told Us at the Real Housewives of New Jersey season 15 premiere party in New York City on Tuesday, November 17. “I would love that because my daughters, especially my youngest — Joe left when she was 6 years old. Her dad hasn’t been here, and now she’s 17, so it’s been a long time. If he could come back, I mean, I would love that. And I paid back all the restitution, everything.”

Teresa went on to explain that Joe had lived in the United States since he was 1 year old.

“Joe’s mother became an American citizen when he was 19. If his mother would have become an American citizen before he was 18, he would have never gotten deported,” she said. “But his dad did it before he was 18, but the law changed that the mother had to do it before he was 18.”

Teresa Giudice Supports Ex-Husband Joe as He Asks for Presidential Pardon  

Teresa and Joe, who married in 1999, filed for bankruptcy in 2009, claiming they had $11 million in debt. Five years later, the pair were indicted on fraud charges and pleaded guilty. Teresa served 11 months of a 15-month prison sentence in 2015 while Joe served 41 months and was sent back to Italy after his 2019 release. Teresa filed for divorce from Joe that same year before finalizing the case in 2020. She has since married Luis “Louie” Ruelas in 2022.

Joe now resides in the Bahamas and is unable to return to the United States, where his…

items.title: DWTS' Maura Higgins Reveals Samba Move She Initially Struggled to Master
items.summary:
Maura Higgins ’ road to mastering the samba on Dancing With the Stars season 35 was not an easy one.

“At the beginning of the week, I was like, ‘Oh, this bloody samba is really getting me,’” Higgins, 35, exclusively told Us after the Tuesday, November 17, semifinals episode during a joint interview with partner Mark Ballas . “Because Mark was trying to teach me this bounce section, and honestly, the way you actually move your hips with the bounce and the walk, it’s not normal. It doesn’t feel normal on your body. It feels like you should be moving your hips the other way.”

Ballas, 40, chimed in to add, “It’s one of those dances that when you’re learning this technique, it takes a second for the penny to drop, and then when it does, you’re like, ‘Oh, yeah.’ But it’s hard.”

Higgins and Ballas ultimately delivered a perfect routine to “Samba Vocalizado” by Luciano Perrone , earning a combined score of 30 out of 30 from judges Carrie Ann Inaba, Derek Hough and Bruno Tonioli. 

Disney/Eric McCandless 
 “I really had to persevere with it,” Higgins recalled of her process for learning the dance. “When I was about to start my performance tonight, I was like, ‘Oh, I’m just going to have fun.’ And then I got over near the judges’ desk and I started shaking my booty and looking at Bruno. I was, like, looking in his eyes. I was like, ‘No, I just want to have fun.’ And it paid off. I was like, ‘I’m going to shake my ass in Bruno’s face.’”

After their first Latin number, Higgins and Ballas returned to the ballroom for a Viennese waltz to Hozier ’s “Shrike” and earned a 29 out of 30.…

items.title: Pregnant Savannah Chrisley Defends Not Wanting to Vaccinate Her Baby
items.summary:
Savannah Chrisley made a decision against vaccinating her first baby upon his arrival.

“I am not, but again, that is my choice,” Chrisley, 29, said on the Tuesday, November 17, episode of her “Unlocked” podcast . “I have friends who are having babies around the same time … [and] they do believe in all the vaccines. Great, like, you have to do what’s best for you and your family. What I love is I have found a pediatrician who is not a one-size-fits-all.”

Savannah, the daughter of Todd and Julie Chrisley , announced in October that she is expecting her first baby with husband Jason Galanis . (Savannah and Galanis, 56, have been together since 2025, secretly tying the knot in the Cayman Islands this summer amid the podcaster’s pregnancy.)

Before giving birth, Savannah specifically sought out a doctor who’d accept her baby boy as a patient no matter his vaccination status.

Todd Chrisley Slams Negative Comments of Pregnant Daughter Savannah's Body 

“Unfortunately in today’s day and age, that’s what you have to look for because the majority of pediatricians won’t accept you if you don’t vaccinate,” she claimed. “And then, if you choose not to vaccinate while you’re with them, they will drop you as a patient.”

The CDC states that vaccines administered to millions of children in the U.S. each year are safe and effective against infectious diseases such as hepatitis B, chickenpox and measles. Melissa Gorga Admits Filming With New 'RHONJ' Season 15 Cast Was 'Strange'

Instead of sharing what she hopes fans see, Melissa revealed the lessons she hopes viewers take away from her journey with Teresa.

“If anything, I hope we inspire someone out there to pick up the phone and call a family member — an aunt, an uncle, a cousin, a sister that they don’t speak to anymore,” she continued. “That’s what I hope.”

The Beckhams have made an art of monetising their every move. But apparently there are limits to where they’re prepared to sell their wares

Thoughts and half-price prayers with Poundland, please. The discount chain has been on the verge of collapse for a while, and its future looks bleak. Now, to add to the ignominy, David Beckham is kicking it while it’s down.

Not literally, by the way: I suppose I should spell that out since we’re dealing with a litigious billionaire. Rather, DB Ventures, the licensor of the David Beckham brand, is causing a bit of a stink about the fact that the football legend’s fragrance range was found on sale in the discount store as well as at other purveyors of budget goods. It is now suing the perfume company, Coty, which it further accuses of under reporting sales, for $41m (£31m).

Another panellist, the TV presenter Dermot O’Leary, mimed picking up a phone and said: “When you’re dancing tonight, do you mind having sex afterwards?” Everyone laughed.

items.title: I saw how brightly stars like Russell Brand could shine, but there is darkness in the shadows | Sophie Heawood
items.summary:
After years of celebrity interviews, I have learned not to be fooled by the allure of fame. We never really know them – we know what they want us to know

As I sat in Southwark crown court, listening to the final day of Russell Brand’s trial, there was one subject that came up repeatedly, invoked as often by his defence as the prosecution. I don’t mean sex or coercion, but fame. It ran through every victim impact statement and loomed so large in the courtroom that it felt as if it was almost on trial itself.

I’m an entertainment journalist who has been covering celebrities for more than 20 years – as long as Brand has been one – and I have written about him at various stages of his career. But I went to Southwark crown court as a member of the public who wanted to see justice done. For the women he had hurt, for the ones who couldn’t get as far as the courtroom, and for all of us who came of age at a time when rape culture was so fast and furious that young women mistook it for a joke that we were in on. In the age of lads’ mags, sex felt cheapened, yet somehow we were the ones who ended up paying for this. So it was doubly strange to sit in court and feel somehow complicit in it - in how this media culture had encouraged Russell Brand.

Continue reading...
items.t: I saw how brightly stars like Russell Brand could shine, but there is darkness in the shadows | Sophie Heawood

items.title: Two courtrooms, one celebrity: how did the Russell Brand case compare with the rape trial next door?
items.summary:
One was a high-profile defendant watched by more than 100 journalists. Another was an unknown man who preyed on a girl almost half his age. Their stories played out minutes apart, one entirely out of the spotlight

What is going on inside Russell Brand’s head as he arrives at court for the start of his rape trial? He sees the dozens of cameras and journalists lined outside Southwark crown court, many of whom have been waiting since before 7am, and he tells himself that the media are all against him. “It seems to me that they believe that I am guilty, and that this should be the rubber-stamping of the process of my destruction.”

He walks with his wife, Laura, and his bodyguard past the photographers, “clickering, clackering, snickering paparazzi, like locusts, peculiar concoctions, not fully humans”, and up into the court, where he is suddenly overwhelmed by “the presence of something very beautiful, grace”. “In a situation like I’m in, it’s impossible not to turn to God. Truth and justice are the only things that can save me,” he thinks.
